g.text: JEV Open Source: System One Architecture & Operational Data Flow
Non-Autoregressive Decision Engine with Excised Language Model Head & Dual-Mode Decision Heads
Serializes heterogeneous state, query type, and dynamic candidate pools into structured token streams
1.2 DecisionDataCollator: Delimiter Stream Serialization & Span Mapping
Maps char offsets [s_k, e_k] → token indices [t_start(k), t_end(k)]
decide_tok_idx = seq_len - 1 (points to terminal decision marker)
Transformer Backbone Execution & Generative LM Head Excision
Single forward prefill pass excising vocabulary projection to reclaim ~778 MB VRAM and eliminate autoregression
2.1 Foundation Backbone: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (4-bit NF4 Quantization + LoRA Adapters)
• Modules: q, k, v, o, gate, up, down
2.2 Excised Generative Head: nn.Identity() [Reclaiming ~778 MB VRAM]
Latent Feature Slicing & Span Representation Pooling
Extracts terminal decision token embedding and aggregates candidate option token spans via mean pooling
3.2 Candidate Span Token Pooling (Dynamic K Options)
e_k = MeanPool(H[:, t_start(k) : t_end(k), :]) ∈ ℝ^(1536), k ∈ {0, ..., K-1}
Candidate Keys Matrix E_cands = [e_0; e_1; ...; e_K-1] ∈ ℝ^(K × 1536)
Dual-Mode Hybrid Decision Heads (Static Invariant Anchors + Dynamic Pointer)
Decouples invariant semantic categories from unbounded in-context candidates
Mode A: Static Linear Prototypes (Semantically Invariant Primitives)
Branch A1: Noul Prototype (Calibrated Binary Verification / Grounding)
Branch A2: Score Ordinal Anchor (Metric-Aware Rubric Levels L ∈ [2, 10])
✓ Penalizes metric distance, not nominal error
Mode B: Dynamic In-Context Candidate Pointer (Open-Ended Choice)
Key Architectural Breakthrough: In-Context Key Matching vs. Static Slots
Static heads fail on open-ended choices because slot 0 has no permanent meaning across prompts. Mode B projects candidates to semantic keys k_i.
Deterministic Operational Outputs, Loss Mechanics & Empirical Benchmarks
Evaluated on 28k multi-domain samples across 15 tasks (Banking77, CLINC150, MNLI, SNLI, UNFAIR-ToS, SummEval)
Output: ŷ_score = ∑ l · p_l (Active L Levels)
• Entropy Regularizer: β · 𝔼[∑ p log p]
Figure 1 | End-to-end architecture and operational data flow of the JEV System One decision engine. Unlike autoregressive LLMs that execute dozens of sequential decoding steps,
JEV evaluates structured operational decisions in a single forward prefill pass over input state S and typed query Q. Excising the 151k-dimension LM head reclaims ~778 MB VRAM
and brings operational footprint under 2.0 GB. The Dual-Mode Head decouples invariant binary/ordinal anchors (Mode A) from open-ended in-context candidate pointer representations (Mode B),
completely eliminating coordinate and positional bias while outputting calibrated probabilities.
